decision.reason: [ev-6ec6b4ea132d] is just a one-line release-note title, "Drop Support for Log Config, Add Log Paths", plus a link to PR #6586. It doesn't say what "Log Config" is (Helm value, ConfigMap, flag), what "Log Paths" are, or whether one replaces the other. It also doesn't say what happens to environments that still set log config, so subject, change, applicability and consequence can't be typed. The PR or upgrade-guide text is needed to name the removed and added settings and to say what happens if nobody acts.
